notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood after 6-week hosted API trial. Primary intent: migrate heavy user-facing chat + doc-summarization flows to Dedicated for cost predictability and lower p95 latency.
Hosted trial highlights: internal QA + small cohort of customers (beta) used hosted_api for 4 weeks. Observed traffic pattern: baseline 8 QPS, peak bursts to 55 QPS during product releases.
Trial measured metrics: average tokens/request 820, median 410 tokens. Token mix during trial: 55% short (<256), 35% mid (256-1024), 10% long (>1024).
Daily activity: averaged ~40k requests/day across features during beta (approx 33M tokens/day). Expect growth 2-3x in next 6 months if rollout goes well.

Latency goals: product team wants p95 <250ms for chat and <400ms for summarization calls. During hosted trial we saw p95=220ms for <512-token requests, p95=520ms for >2k-token requests (streaming enabled).
Throughput / concurrency targets for Dedicated: target sustained 40 QPS with headroom to 120 QPS bursts; concurrency per model ~20-30 streams; desire auto-burst capability and predictable cost model.

Dedicated sizing ask: preliminary estimate requested by TradeWind: 4-6 GPU nodes (A100-class) to meet p95 SLA at current token mix, or smaller nodes with aggressive batching if Redwood recommends quantized variants. TradeWind prefers vendor to validate sizing with Redwood-run POC.
Cost sensitivity: Finance wants modeled spend to stay in $150k-400k ARR bucket for first year of Dedicated — need per-token and per-hour burst pricing lines. Quote request submitted 2026-03-02.

Security/regulatory: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained 2+ years, and EU data residency for some enterprise customers. Legal reviewing Redwood DPA now.

Quote & procurement: AE provided Hosted usage export and recommended Dedicated baseline. Customer asked for month-by-month forecast and breakpoints for reserved vs burst capacity. Pricing deck linked.
Customer quotes: 'Host trial was great — latency noticeable on our heaviest summarization workflows; we need lower tail latency and cost predictability for Q3 rollout.'

POC plan: Redwood to run 3-day Dedicated POC with synthetic traffic profile (token mix & QPS) — deliverables: validated GPU count, expected p95 latencies, and cost estimate for steady-state + 3x burst. SE to own load profile sheet.

Action items: AE (Alex) to send traffic profile spreadsheet; SE (Priya) to produce sizing sketch and run modelling; Finance lead at TradeWind to provide ARR ceilings and expected ramp timeline (weekly active users projection).
Risks: if Dedicated estimate is >$0.0012/token equivalent, internal board may push for hybrid route (hosted + cache) or alternative providers. Also legal KMS/residency timeline may delay procurement.
Internal notes: Opportunity fits Redwood positioning (hosted -> dedicated motion). Strong chance to close if POC confirms 6-node or fewer sizing and pricing aligns with finance targets.
